content.text: Is the US stock market open today or closed on Good Friday 2026? Are banks open and is USPS delivering mail today. Good Friday 2026 falls on April 3, and millions of Americans are asking the same question: what’s closed on Good Friday and will banks and mail services operate normally? The answer is surprisingly simple—most services remain open, but key financial markets shut down completely. Despite not being a federal holiday, Good Friday still impacts major sectors, especially Wall Street. Both Nasdaq and New York Stock Exchange will be closed, even as banks, stores, and delivery services continue operations. For everyday life, this creates a mixed scenario. The United States Postal Service will deliver mail as usual, and most banks will stay open. However, some state-level closures and school holidays may affect schedules locally. If you’re planning errands, banking, or deliveries, understanding exactly what’s open and closed on Good Friday 2026 can save time and confusion. When people search “what’s closed on Good Friday,” the biggest and most consistent closure is the U.S. stock market. On April 3, 2026, trading will be completely halted across major exchanges. This includes both the Nasdaq and the New York Stock Exchange, making it one of the few non-federal holidays that still shuts down Wall Street. Beyond financial markets, closures vary by state. Good Friday is officially recognized as a public holiday in states like Delaware and New Jersey. In these areas, state government offices, courts, and some municipal services may not operate. This can include reduced public transport schedules or delays in services like waste collection. Schools are another major sector affected. Many school districts align Good Friday with spring break or Easter holidays, meaning classrooms will be empty across large parts of the country. However, federal offices and most nationwide services continue functioning normally, which often confuses people expecting a full shutdown. Are banks open on Good Friday 2026 or closed? A common search trend every year is: “Are banks open on Good Friday?” The short answer is yes—most banks are open. Since Good Friday is not a federal banking holiday, major institutions like Chase, Bank of America, and Wells Fargo typically operate during regular business hours. However, there can be small variations. Some regional banks or branches in states observing Good Friday as a public holiday may operate on reduced hours or close early. Still, the majority of customers will find full access to in-branch services, ATMs, and digital banking platforms. Online banking remains unaffected, allowing users to transfer funds, pay bills, or check balances anytime. This consistency is crucial, especially during a holiday weekend when spending tends to increase due to travel, dining, and shopping.Is USPS delivering mail on Good Friday and are couriers running? Another high-intent query is: “Is there mail delivery on Good Friday 2026?” The answer is clear—yes, mail will be delivered as usual. The United States Postal Service does not observe Good Friday as a holiday, so operations continue without interruption. This means regular mail delivery, package drop-offs, and post office services will follow standard schedules on April 3. Private courier companies like UPS and FedEx also maintain their normal operations, ensuring that shipments arrive on time. For businesses and individuals relying on logistics, this is a major advantage. There are no expected nationwide delays tied specifically to Good Friday. However, slight variations in local office hours can still occur, so checking ahead is always a smart move.What’s open on Good Friday and what changes for Easter Sunday? While many wonder what’s closed on Good Friday, the bigger disruption actually comes two days later—Easter Sunday (April 5, 2026). On Good Friday itself, most retailers, grocery stores, and restaurants remain open and operate under normal hours. This includes supermarkets, shopping malls, pharmacies, and dining chains. In fact, many businesses see increased foot traffic as people prepare for Easter celebrations. Restaurants and cafes remain fully operational, making it easy for families to dine out or grab last-minute meals. Easter Sunday, however, tells a different story. Major retailers like Target, Costco, and many department stores close for the day. Some grocery chains and pharmacies also shut down or reduce hours. Restaurants may operate on limited schedules, and certain chains close entirely. This contrast is important. Good Friday is largely a normal business day with selective closures, while Easter Sunday brings widespread shutdowns across retail and services.Why is Good Friday observed if it’s not a federal holiday? Good Friday holds deep religious significance, commemorating the crucifixion of Jesus Christ. It is observed during Holy Week, which began with Palm Sunday on March 29, 2026, and ends with Easter Sunday on April 5. Despite its importance in Christianity, Good Friday is not classified as a federal holiday in the United States. This is why federal institutions and most businesses remain open. However, its recognition at the state level explains why closures vary across regions. The shifting date of Easter also plays a role. Unlike fixed holidays, Good Friday changes every year, falling anywhere between late March and late April. In 2026, it aligns closely with Passover (April 1–9), creating an overlap of major religious observances.FAQs:Is the stock market open today on Good Friday 2026? No, the U.S. stock market is closed on April 3, 2026. Both the Nasdaq and New York Stock Exchange remain shut for the holiday, pausing all trading activity. Are banks open on Good Friday 2026 in the US? Yes, most banks are open on Good Friday 2026. Major banks operate regular hours, though some local branches may follow reduced schedules depending on state observance. Is USPS delivering mail on Good Friday 2026? Yes, the United States Postal Service delivers mail as usual on April 3. There are no nationwide postal service disruptions. Are UPS and FedEx delivering on Good Friday? Yes, both UPS and FedEx continue normal pickup and delivery services on Good Friday, ensuring shipments arrive on time. Is Good Friday a federal holiday in the United States? No, Good Friday is not a federal holiday. However, it is recognized as a public holiday in some states like Delaware and New Jersey, leading to selective closures.
